title: Add Batch Imagine to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Batch Imagine](https://batchimagine.netlify.app) to image
- **Batch Imagine** is a free, open-source AI batch image generator built with React + Vite, powered entirely by the Pollinations.ai API.

Fixes #11278

gist.headline: Images, in bunches
gist.blurb: Batch Imagine joined the garden: a free, open-source batch image generator built with React, Vite, and the Pollinations API. One prompt is nice; a whole patch of variations is nicer.
gist.summary: Added Batch Imagine, a free open-source React + Vite app that generates AI images in batches through the Pollinations.ai API, to the community app listings.
gist.impact: People looking to create many image variations can now discover Batch Imagine directly through Pollinations' app directory.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a cheerful garden worker wearing a tiny tool belt, tending a row of blooming image-flowers that each display a different pixel-art landscape. A friendly CRT monitor robot helps sort the generated pictures into neat batches beside a retro terminal, making the batch-generation idea immediately visible.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny tool belt, tending a garden where rows of lime green (#ecf874) flower pots bloom into small framed AI image variations; a cute CRT monitor robot sorts the pictures into labeled batches beside a retro computer. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green and pastel mint-lavender-peach gradient background, code-vines and tiny flowers, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, pixel-font text: 'BATCH IMAGINE', nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
